correctness.rationale: For each odd N≥3 and distinct slopes, normalized quadratic Gauss sums at difference d=a−c and modulation offset ell have |G_N(d,ell)|²=Ng if g=gcd(d,N) divides ell, otherwise zero; this follows from grouping by g and the invertible (x−y,x+y) transform modulo odd N/g. Precisely N²/g modulation pairs are nonzero, yielding fourth-overlap cross-basis contribution g, while same slope contributes N. Thus Phi_2(A)=rN+2Σ_{unordered pairs}gcd(a−c,N). The classical identity gcd(k,N)=Σ_{m|gcd(k,N)}φ(m) rewrites the objective as a positive weighted sum of residue-binomial collisions modulo every m|N. For fixed r each collision sum is minimized exactly when m residue occupancies differ by ≤1, with C_m(r), and a cyclic consecutive r-interval attains all individual minima simultaneously. Positivity of every φ(m) proves the complete simultaneous balancing equality test and the nonnegative deficit. Full proof holds all odd N and r, including r=1,N; independent exhaustive integer check on all 2723 nonempty subsets for N=3,5,7,9,11 and bounded quadratic Gauss checks corroborated the arithmetic only.
residual_risks: Oddness is essential for the Gauss modulus via invertibility of 2; does not include repeated slope multisets.
